title: Building Covered Linkways to Connect HDB Blocks, Amenities and MRT Stations Beyond 400-metre Radius
what_it_is: Building Covered Linkways to Connect HDB Blocks, Amenities and MRT Stations Beyond 400-metre Radius

sections.label: Covered linkways near MRT stations
sections.summary: LTA announced more covered linkways connecting MRT stations to Friendly Streets and nearby amenities within 800 metres, and MOT considers extending these to HDB blocks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2024, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) announced that it would build more covered linkways to connect Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations to designated Friendly Streets and some key amenities nearby that are within an 800-metre radius of the stations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: We are glad that the Ministry of Transport (MOT) already has the policy to build covered linkways to amenities within 800 metres of MRT stations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: We hope MOT could also consider building covered linkways within 800 metres of an MRT station that would link to Housing and Development Board blocks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: Because there are previous examples where LTA built the linkways according to the policy but served very few residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
sentences.text: So, we hope that LTA or MOT can stretch the policy a bit more, so that it would benefit more residents based on the human traffic flow to MRT stations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: In evaluating proposals, LTA will look at usage patterns – as the Member said, how residents commute within that radius.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But we also need to look at site constraints and also safety requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We would definitely prioritise walkways that connect large numbers of commuters to major public destinations, and these would primarily include walkways which connects transport nodes and major amenities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We definitely will take in feedback and requests from the community and pay special attention to the needs of our more vulnerable commuters.
